name: Improve Batch Init By ATS

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      max_jobs:
        description: "Only run first N rows from batch_init.csv (0 = all rows)."
        required: true
        default: "0"
      max_parallel:
        description: "Maximum parallel matrix jobs."
        required: true
        default: "24"
  push:
    paths:
      - "batch_init.csv"
      - "improve_batch_init_ats.py"
      - "Source_revised2/**/*.py"
      - ".github/workflows/improve-batch-init-ats.yml"
      - "requirements.txt"

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

env:
  MAX_JOBS: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.max_jobs || '0' }}
  MAX_PARALLEL: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.max_parallel || '24' }}

jobs:
  build-matrix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.make-matrix.outputs.matrix }}
      total_jobs: ${{ steps.make-matrix.outputs.total_jobs }}
      max_parallel: ${{ steps.set-parallel.outputs.max_parallel }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
            pip install -r requirements.txt
          fi

      - name: Build matrix from batch_init.csv
        id: make-matrix
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python improve_batch_init_ats.py \
            --input-csv batch_init.csv \
            --emit-matrix matrix.json \
            --max-jobs "$MAX_JOBS"

          TOTAL_JOBS=$(python - <<'PY'
          import json
          with open("matrix.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
              print(len(json.load(f)))
          PY
          )

          echo "matrix=$(cat matrix.json)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "total_jobs=$TOTAL_JOBS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "total_jobs=$TOTAL_JOBS"

      - name: Export max_parallel
        id: set-parallel
        run: echo "max_parallel=${MAX_PARALLEL}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  improve-matrix:
    needs: build-matrix
    if: ${{ needs.build-matrix.outputs.total_jobs != '0' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 210
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: ${{ fromJson(needs.build-matrix.outputs.max_parallel) }}
      matrix:
        row: ${{ fromJson(needs.build-matrix.outputs.matrix) }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
            pip install -r requirements.txt
          fi

      - name: Improve one row with ATS
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python improve_batch_init_ats.py \
            --input-csv batch_init.csv \
            --row-index "${{ matrix.row.row_index }}" \
            --parallel-runs 3 \
            --nimp 50 \
            --seg 4 \
            --div 3 \
            --max-runtime-sec 7200 \
            --output-json "row_${{ matrix.row.row_index }}.json"

      - name: Upload row artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: batch-init-row-${{ matrix.row.row_index }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: row_${{ matrix.row.row_index }}.json

  merge-results:
    needs: [build-matrix, improve-matrix]
    if: ${{ always() && needs.build-matrix.outputs.total_jobs != '0' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
            pip install -r requirements.txt
          fi

      - name: Download all row artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: batch-init-row-*-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: row_results
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Merge improved rows
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python improve_batch_init_ats.py \
            --input-csv batch_init.csv \
            --merge-results-dir row_results \
            --output-csv Result/batch_init_ats_improved.csv \
            --output-detail-csv Result/batch_init_ats_improved_detail.csv

      - name: Write summary
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import csv
          import os

          out_csv = "Result/batch_init_ats_improved.csv"
          detail_csv = "Result/batch_init_ats_improved_detail.csv"
          rows = 0
          ok = 0
          err = 0
          if os.path.exists(detail_csv):
              with open(detail_csv, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                  for r in csv.DictReader(f):
                      rows += 1
                      if r.get("status") == "OK":
                          ok += 1
                      else:
                          err += 1

          summary_path = os.environ["GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"]
          with open(summary_path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as out:
              out.write("# Improve Batch Init ATS Summary\n\n")
              out.write(f"- total_rows: {rows}\n")
              out.write(f"- ok_rows: {ok}\n")
              out.write(f"- error_rows: {err}\n")
              out.write(f"- improved_csv: `{out_csv}`\n")
              out.write(f"- detail_csv: `{detail_csv}`\n")
          PY

      - name: Upload merged artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: batch-init-ats-improved-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            Result/batch_init_ats_improved.csv
            Result/batch_init_ats_improved_detail.csv
